note_ko: 표정 사전(해부학적 서술). 감정 이름 대신 얼굴 부위별로 눈에 보이는 변화(눈썹, 눈, 볼, 입꼬리, 입술·치아, 턱)를 적는다. 근육 이름은 쓰지 않는다. main_en은 보통/상세 모두, echo_en은 같은 표정을 다른 표현으로 한 번 더, echo2_en은 두 번째 반복. {p}/{P}=her/Her. 눈을 가늘게 만드는 말(narrow, squint, half-closed)은 웃음 표현에 쓰지 않는다.

환한 미소.desc_ko: 볼이 올라가고 눈꼬리가 접히며 입술이 벌어져 윗니가 보이는 활짝 웃음
환한 미소.parts_ko: 눈썹 편안 / 볼 올라감 / 눈꼬리 접힘 / 입꼬리 위로 / 입술 벌어짐 / 윗니
환한 미소.main_en: looking directly at the camera with a wide, genuine smile: {p} cheeks rise and press the lower eyelids upward into soft creases at the outer corners of {p} eyes, the corners of {p} mouth pull up and back, {p} lips part to show the upper teeth, and {p} brows stay relaxed and slightly lifted
환한 미소.echo_en: The smile involves {p} whole face, with lifted cheeks, creased outer eye corners and the upper teeth showing
환한 미소.echo2_en: A bright, open smile lifts {p} cheeks, creases the corners of {p} eyes upward and parts {p} lips

은은한 미소.desc_ko: 입을 다문 채 입꼬리만 살짝 올라가는 조용한 미소
은은한 미소.parts_ko: 눈썹 편안 / 눈 편안히 뜸 / 볼 살짝 / 입꼬리 살짝 위로 / 입술 닫힘
은은한 미소.main_en: looking directly at the camera with a soft closed-lip smile: the corners of {p} mouth lift slightly, {p} cheeks rise just a little, {p} eyes stay relaxed and open, and {p} brows rest softly
은은한 미소.echo_en: {P} lips stay gently closed while the corners of {p} mouth curve upward
은은한 미소.echo2_en: {P} face is calm, with only a faint upward curve at the corners of {p} lips

수줍은 미소.desc_ko: 턱을 살짝 당기고 눈을 올려 보며 입술을 다문 채 웃는 수줍은 미소
수줍은 미소.parts_ko: 턱 당김 / 올려보는 시선 / 입꼬리 살짝 / 입술 다묾 / 볼 은은하게 붉음
수줍은 미소.main_en: glancing up at the camera with a shy smile: {p} chin tucked slightly, the corners of {p} mouth lifted with the lips pressed gently together, {p} eyes looking up from under softly lowered upper lids, and a faint flush on {p} cheeks
수줍은 미소.echo_en: {P} head dips a little as {p} eyes look up at the camera, a small smile on {p} closed lips
수줍은 미소.echo2_en: A shy, closed-lip smile lifts the corners of {p} mouth while {p} chin stays tucked

장난스러운 미소.desc_ko: 한쪽 입꼬리가 먼저 올라가고 한쪽 눈썹이 살짝 올라가는 장난기 있는 미소
장난스러운 미소.parts_ko: 한쪽 입꼬리 높게 / 한쪽 눈썹 올라감 / 눈 반짝임 / 정면 시선
장난스러운 미소.main_en: looking straight into the lens with a playful smirk: one corner of {p} mouth lifts higher than the other, one eyebrow is raised slightly, and {p} eyes are bright and fully open
장난스러운 미소.echo_en: {P} smile tilts to one side, with one raised brow and bright, direct eyes
장난스러운 미소.echo2_en: A teasing, lopsided smile lifts the corner of {p} mouth while {p} eyes stay wide open and lively

메롱.desc_ko: 입술을 벌리고 혀를 아랫입술 위로 내민 장난스러운 표정
메롱.parts_ko: 혀 내밈 / 입술 벌어짐 / 눈 밝게 / 눈썹 올라감
메롱.main_en: looking at the camera while playfully sticking {p} tongue out: {p} lips part and the tongue rests over the lower lip, {p} eyebrows lift slightly, and {p} eyes are bright and fully open
메롱.echo_en: The tip of {p} tongue is out over {p} lower lip, with {p} lips parted and a playful look in {p} eyes
메롱.echo2_en: {P} sticks out {p} tongue with raised brows and bright, wide eyes

놀람.desc_ko: 눈썹이 높이 올라가고 눈이 크게 떠지며 입이 살짝 벌어진 놀란 얼굴
놀람.parts_ko: 눈썹 높이 올라감 / 눈 크게 뜸 / 입 살짝 벌어짐
놀람.main_en: looking at the camera with a surprised face: {p} eyebrows raised high, {p} upper eyelids lifted so the eyes are wide open, and {p} mouth slightly open
놀람.echo_en: {P} brows arch high and {p} eyes open wide, with {p} lips parted in surprise
놀람.echo2_en: Surprise shows in {p} lifted brows, wide eyes and slightly open mouth

윙크.desc_ko: 한쪽 눈을 감고 입꼬리를 살짝 올린 윙크
윙크.parts_ko: 한쪽 눈 감김 / 다른 눈 뜸 / 입꼬리 살짝 위로
윙크.main_en: winking at the camera: one of {p} eyes is closed while the other stays open and bright, and the corner of {p} mouth lifts into a small smile
윙크.echo_en: One eye is closed in a wink, the other open and looking straight at the camera, with a small smile at the corner of {p} mouth
윙크.echo2_en: {P} winks with one eye and keeps the other bright and open, {p} smile tilting up on that side

무표정.desc_ko: 눈썹이 수평이고 눈을 편안히 뜬 채 입술을 가볍게 다문 차분한 얼굴
무표정.parts_ko: 눈썹 수평 / 눈 편안히 뜸 / 볼 매끈 / 입술 닫힘
무표정.main_en: looking directly at the camera with a calm neutral face: {p} brows level and relaxed, {p} eyes open and steady, {p} cheeks smooth, and {p} lips softly closed
무표정.echo_en: {P} face is still and composed, {p} gaze steady and unhurried
무표정.echo2_en: {P} features stay smooth and untroubled, with {p} lips gently closed
